title: We Bare Bears
description: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they’re looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it’s clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x1
episodes_data.description: After the bears play a little pickup basketball (they're very bad), they go back to grab their stuff by the side of the court only to find it's been stolen! The Bears race across town trying to track down their stuff and end up cracking a giant case in the process.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x2
episodes_data.description: The Bears think they have what it takes to make and star in a viral video, but when Nom-Nom decides that they don't, Grizz breaks into the koala's limo in an effort to change his mind.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x3
episodes_data.description: The Bears open up a food truck after being disappointed by the food options available to them. In an effort to drum up business, they start selling their food to animals until the animals go a little crazy.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x4
episodes_data.description: Chloe spends time with the Bears in an effort to research them for an upcoming presentation. But when the Bears sneak a peek at her very dry report, the Bears decide to jazz it up with exaggerated "facts" about themselves and their lifestyle.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x5
episodes_data.description: When a vendor at the Farmer's Market (LUCY) sticks Panda with an EpiPen reviving him after an allergic reaction, Panda comes to in the arms of his dream girl. Panda tries to woo this woman of his dreams but his brothers and his own insecurities get in the way.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x6
episodes_data.description: It's a normal day for the Bears. This means that Ice gets in a fight with a Roomba, Panda's life gets turned upside down when a mouse invades his room and Grizz gets stuck in a tree. You know, everyday stuff for a bear.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x7
episodes_data.description: Grizz likes Burritos. A lot. So much so that after a restaurant makes a Bear-Sized Burrito, Grizz can't bring himself to eat such a majestic work of art. He carries the burrito everywhere making it a new and increasingly smelly part of his life.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x8
episodes_data.description: Have the Bears lost their survival instincts by living in the modern world? Grizz wants to know so he purposefully gets the Bears lost in the deep forest.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x9
episodes_data.description: The Bears find a bedazzled jean jacket in a dumpster. It's just about the coolest thing they've ever seen and seems to make the wearer of the jacket extremely lucky. But after the Bears fight over who gets control of the jacket, they have to consider that their denim blessing has become a curse.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x10
episodes_data.description: When Nom Nom shows up on the Bears' doorstep, disheveled and deposed from his spot as cutest internet star ever after a recent meltdown, he enlists the Bears to help him regain his title.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x11
episodes_data.description: The Bears are fed up with the decay of etiquette at today's theaters. Aren't you? The Bears take it upon themselves to be the police of the theater sneaking up like ninjas to shush people who ruin the movie for others with their bad manners.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x12
episodes_data.description: Chloe, a child prodigy, finds it difficult to connect with her much older classmates. The Bears take her under their wing showing her how to make great college friends.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x13
episodes_data.description: You know that one annoying friend who just can't get the hint? That's Charlie, and he's Bigfoot. The Bears meet him when Charlie signs up on a home-sharing website to spend a weekend with the Bears. Charlie is the worst possible house guest for the Bears and nearly destroys their house.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x14
episodes_data.description: After Panda stumbles and accidentally scares a pack of wolves away in the process, the hierarchy of the Bears is disrupted. Suddenly, Panda has become the alpha bear, and he and Grizz have to deal with the consequences of an emotional Panda being the leader of the three Bears.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x15
episodes_data.description: When the city plans to destroy the Bears' cave in order to make way for a new cell phone tower, Grizz and Panda must find evidence from their past that proves they have rights to their land. And in case that fails, Ice Bear protests and tries to sabotage the construction crew.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x16
episodes_data.description: Panda bears have a very adorable (and violent!) sneeze, and our Panda is no exception. When a Vine video of his very cute sneeze goes viral, Panda becomes a "cute" sensation, which causes Nom Nom to try to fend off of this new challenger to his throne.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x17
episodes_data.description: This episode takes place when the Bears are young cubs! The three bears, on their way through the desert, come upon a giant warehouse. It's like an Amazon fulfillment center. The Bears try to make this box-filled paradise their home.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x18
episodes_data.description: When Grizz comes home with a live crab, he thinks it can become a pet for the brothers to share. However, after the crab pinches Ice Bear's ear and won't let go, Panda and Grizz have to get their injured brother to the hospital, and fast!

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x19
episodes_data.description: When a hipster grocery store clerk shames the Bears for asking for plastic grocery bags, the Bears realize that eco-friendly tote bags are their way of gaining acceptance amongst the progressive people of the Bay Area. But in their effort to gain popularity, the Bears let the culture of tote bags take over their lives.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x20
episodes_data.description: Charlie is a solo guy who, like the Bears, would love to find a place for himself in the world. In an effort to do so, Charlie throws a party, but ends up going on an adventure with the unlikeliest of animals, a wild snake.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x21
episodes_data.description: Panda is an avid e-dater, and when a lovely French woman matches with him and agrees to a video chat date, Panda and his brothers engineer the situation so Panda is able to show the best side of himself on the video chat, even if that side of him is completely exaggerated.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x22
episodes_data.description: Pet Shop tells the tale of where the Baby Bears once lived, and after a run-in with a video crew shooting a Sarah McLachlan-type animal adoption video, almost seized an opportunity to find a home separated from each other.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x23
episodes_data.description: On a day out with just Ice Bear, Chloe realizes Ice Bear only runs errands for his brothers. Determined to show him a fun day in the city, Chloe promises to help Ice Bear have a good time, even if it means staying in a museum after it closes.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x24
episodes_data.description: When the Bears' beloved laptop breaks, they finally have the need to do something they've never done before: get jobs. Working at a trendy cupcake shop, the Bears find that the working world is much tougher than they realized.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 1x25
episodes_data.description: Grizz drives his brothers crazy preparing for winter hibernation.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x1
episodes_data.description: After Panda gets injured on the basketball court, the Bears invite Charlie to be on their basketball team. But when Charlie gets too good, he starts to ruin all the fun of the game.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x2
episodes_data.description: Each of the Bears get offbeat items at a local yard sale. Their new possessions send them on their own separate adventures.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x3
episodes_data.description: A thunderstorm forces Chloe to spend the night at the Cave with the Bears. When Chloe's parents tell the Bears to protect Chloe, they take the task a bit too seriously.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x4
episodes_data.description: A doctor tells the Bears to go on a cleanse to improve their health. But when Grizz realizes he can only eat what grizzly bears eat, he starts to lose his mind.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x5
episodes_data.description: Nom Nom recruits the Bears to act as his entourage of friends. But when the Bears realize Nom Nom doesn't understand friendship, they decide to kick their day of bonding into high gear.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x6
episodes_data.description: To recover a missing package, the Bears get help from Ranger Tabes, an eccentric forest ranger. But her overblown sense of justice might be too much for the Bears to handle.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x7
episodes_data.description: The Bears switch bedrooms for the night and get a glimpse of the living space of one of their brothers. But the deeper they go, hidden secrets are revealed.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x8
episodes_data.description: Feeling unappreciated, Ice Bear leaves his brothers to be the chef of a restaurant. Desperate to fill the void, Grizz and Panda look for Ice Bear's replacement.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x9
episodes_data.description: Fed up with sharing, Panda forbids his brothers from using his cellphone any longer. But when the brothers get their own super advanced smartphones, Panda starts to succumb to crippling jealousy.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x10
episodes_data.description: In order to abide by the clothing policy of their favorite Boba shop, the Bears get some new outfits. But with new looks come new lives including office work, fashion modeling and even falling in love!

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x11
episodes_data.description: While trying to sail to Japan, the Baby Bears get stranded on an island. Luckily, they meet Dave and Karla, who help with survival on the island while looking for an escape.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x12
episodes_data.description: The Bears become terribly ill and Chloe takes it upon herself to take care of them. But things get tricky when word of the Bears' sickness goes viral.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x13
episodes_data.description: Panda needs to meet his brothers at the most exclusive restaurant in town. But when he loses his contacts lenses and can't see, Panda needs Charlie's help to get him into the city.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x14
episodes_data.description: The Bears audition to be the next mascot for their favorite cereal. They get so caught up in the process that their competitiveness gets the best of them.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x15
episodes_data.description: The Bears are reunited with their pet crab, Captain Craboo. But after an unfortunate run-in with Nom Nom, the Bears may lose their pet forever.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x16
episodes_data.description: The Baby Bears have an adventure in the sky while aboard a plane to Sweden. But when the baby Bears are forced to sit in different sections of the plan, things get a bit haywire for everyone on board.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x17
episodes_data.description: Baby Ice Bear lives alone in the arctic and meets a mysterious man named Yuri. Together they help each other survive the cold environment.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x18
episodes_data.description: Ice Bear rides his custom vacuum into the city. But when a gang of techies steal the vacuum, Ice Bear goes on a rescue mission that takes him through the underground world of the city.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x19
episodes_data.description: Through a standard video browsing session online, we get a glimpse of the different kinds of videos the Bears have posted.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x20
episodes_data.description: Ranger Tabes tells the Bears she's been investigating a mysterious creature. But when the Bears realize she's actually investigating their friend Charlie, they split up to ensure Charlie's safety.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x21
episodes_data.description: The Bears find Chloe in the library exhausted from studying for an exam all day. The Bears stay to help Chloe study but make things worse in the process.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x22
episodes_data.description: When his brothers don't need his help for the day, Grizz leaves the cave to assist anyone he can throughout the city.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 2x23
episodes_data.description: The Bears have been invited to all their friends' Christmas parties. In an effort to have time to crash Nom Nom's huge star-studded bash, the Bears first try to make quick stops at all their friends' parties throughout the night.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x1
episodes_data.description: Grizz gets cast in a movie about a Grizzly Bear! But Grizz soon realizes the movie's depiction of grizzly bears is not what he had in mind.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x2
episodes_data.description: The bears become stranded on a subway platform after missing their train, but while waiting, they must recover some lost items.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x3
episodes_data.description: In order to appear on a successful kids show, Nom Nom must complete anger management- with Grizz as his therapist.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x4
episodes_data.description: Panda uses an app to find a friend with whom he has more in common, but things take a turn for the worse when the new friend gets too possessive.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x5
episodes_data.description: The baby bears' dreams come true when they discover a $100 bill; but when they can't bear to spend it, they have difficulty letting go.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x6
episodes_data.description: New neighbors set up camp next to the cave. The bears love it at first, but when Grizz overhears them talking about their questionable previous bear encounters, he begins an investigation.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x7
episodes_data.description: When Chloe’s professor is too mean to give her any face time to talk over her failing grade, the bears take matters into their own hands by kidnapping him. However, this professor turns out to be rather conniving and has the bears turn on each other.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x8
episodes_data.description: Charlie meets a creature just like him named Ralph (voiced by John DiMaggio) and befriends him, but Ralph turns out to be a cruel prankster which troubles the bears.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x9
episodes_data.description: In a BBC-style nature documentary, an omniscient narrator covers the bears' morning when they run out of food and must head to the grocery store.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x10
episodes_data.description: When they learn that Ice Bear is a talented barista, the bears turn the cave into a popular coffee shop. However, things go awry when in order to keep up their coffee's quality, Grizz and Panda give Ice Bear some caffeine despite his warnings.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x11
episodes_data.description: When Charlie hurts his foot while trying to adjust the bears' satellite dish, the bears must sneak him into a hospital for medical assistance.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x12
episodes_data.description: While playing with a potato gun, Chloe and Ice Bear lose her prized hoodie to the dog, nicknamed The Demon, next door so they set out on a mission to retrieve it.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x13
episodes_data.description: For his community college art project, Panda is inspired to paint a picture of Charlie. Panda gives the painting to Charlie, but when he is offered a chance to showcase his art, Panda must get the painting back.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x14
episodes_data.description: Ranger Tabes leads a troop of young girls into a cave expedition, and brings Grizz as their cave expert. However, things get intense when Tabes and Grizz butt heads.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x15
episodes_data.description: While Grizz and Ice Bear help Lucy with her deliveries, Panda tries to impress Lucy by taking care of her allergic younger brother, Clifford.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x16
episodes_data.description: The baby bears become prizes for a carnival game in hopes of being won and taken to a new home, but the game owner will do anything to keep the Bears from leaving.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x17
episodes_data.description: When the local lake is overcrowded with tourists, the Bears have fun at Charlie’s private lake. However, trouble rises when the Bears mistakenly make its presence known on social media.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x18
episodes_data.description: The Bears have lunch with Ranger Tabes, but when Tabes's lunch gets stolen, Tabes goes into full on detective mode to find the culprit.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x19
episodes_data.description: Chloe and the Bears take a road trip to see a meteor shower. Ice Bear, the only one licensed to drive, is put in charge, which becomes harder than he thought, especially when they pick up a hitchhiker.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x20
episodes_data.description: Panda goes on a mission to return a lost phone to the girl of his dreams and encounters various obstacles along the way including the Mad Scientist from "Grizz Helps".

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x21
episodes_data.description: The Bears encounter a kitten that they decide to adopt and name Thunderbolt, however they quickly discover that the kitten is actually a cougar cub and that its cougar family have made themselves at home in the cave.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x22
episodes_data.description: Grizz screens an epic amateur movie he just made for a focus group, but when he notices people and animals are leaving he must figure out ways to keep the audience engaged.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x23
episodes_data.description: After talking about his lost family on a talk show, Nom Nom is met with another Koala named Kyle who claims to be his brother. However, Nom Nom's bodyguard begins to have his suspicions.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x24
episodes_data.description: After Ranger Tabes accidentally breaks a deer's antler, she quits her job and turns to an online craft service, the Bears do what they can to coax her out of retirement when they realize nature's not the same without her.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x25
episodes_data.description: Panda volunteers to be Lucy's partner for a dance contest to win a produce truck. But Panda doesn't have the heart to tell Lucy that she's a terrible dancer. His attempts to forfeit the contest soon hurt his friend’s feelings.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x26
episodes_data.description: Ice Bear gets a sinister message from Barry (from "Icy Nights") and must rescue his friend Yana. He falls into a trap and both he and Yana must escape.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x27
episodes_data.description: While their cave gets fumigated for a cockroach infestation, the Bears check into the Waggington Dog Hotel for the night. Panda and Ice Bear leave due to disliking the hotel's rules, but Grizzly wants to stay. When he gets mistaken for a rabid dog, his brothers must save him.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x28
episodes_data.description: To raise money to save Darrell's store, the Bears use the stack as a taxi through a ride share app, eventually they run into Darrell's landlord and the Bears must outrun him before the landlord gets to Darrell's store and tears it down.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x29
episodes_data.description: During Nom Nom's new TV show, all his special guests end up unable to appear, so Nom Nom hires the Bears as the replacements, but each act gets ruined by their antics.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x30
episodes_data.description: After being excluded from a board game with the Bears and Charlie because of his additude, Ralph takes over the Bear's cave overnight and turns it into a snowy fortress where he reigns as king over everybody.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x31
episodes_data.description: The Bears have a relaxing day at the spa. Grizz tries to get everything the spa has to offer, Panda gets trapped in the steam room with an old man, and Ice Bear plays ping pong.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x32
episodes_data.description: Charlie tells a group of trick or treaters two scary stories for Halloween: The Bears buy three dolls that look like them that come to life and try to murder them and Grizz accidentally bites Chloe who slowly transforms into a werebear.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x33
episodes_data.description: While the baby bears are on their way to the Denver Chocolate Fest, they encounter a burrow of bunnies who are constantly under attack by crows. Grizz and Ice Bear want to help them, but Panda is determined to get to the festival.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x34
episodes_data.description: Grizz befriends a single footed pigeon named Brenda and her friends. When they ask him to help break out more of their pigeon brethren, Grizz is willing to help, only to discover that her fellow pigeons are the pigeon cartel from "Our Stuff".

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x35
episodes_data.description: Baby Panda happily lives in a closed off environment for study. But when he's given a new friend, Panda 2, his worldview is shaken, which sets him off on a great adventure.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x36
episodes_data.description: In search of some adventure, the Bears ride a tube down a dangerous river.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x37
episodes_data.description: The Baby Bears sign up for a game of laser tag, hoping to win some ice cream. But, the round of laser tag turns out to be less of a game and more like a war zone.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x38
episodes_data.description: Ranger Tabes once again leads the Poppy Rangers in a kick ball tournament against their rivals Ranger Jao and the Ivy Rangers. Grizz comes along as a cheerleader, but when Wallace hurts her ankle he gets promoted to player.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x39
episodes_data.description: Chloe and Ice Bear drive up north to find the perfect Christmas tree and while looking for one, they stumble upon a wild turkey while Grizz and Panda are left in charge to decorate Chloe’s house but have a lot of trouble.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x40
episodes_data.description: The Baby Bears help a teenager named Nate accomplish his dream of being a famous singer, but when he wants to enter a talent show and can only enter with the accompany of a guardian, the Baby Bears disguise themselves as Nate’s father.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x41
episodes_data.description: The Bears participate in a brother-themed game show against Panda's BFF, Tom and his roommates Griff and Isaac for a brand new luxury apartment, but when Panda hears that Tom can’t afford his current apartment anymore and that him and his roommates might split up, Panda might have to sacrifice the game.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x42
episodes_data.description: Professor Lampwick covers how everything is connected to the Bears when a hurricane rolls in. When the Bears are in three different locations, Grizz looks after Ranger Tabes' Poppy Rangers, Panda is stuck with Charlie in his car in the forest, and Chloe and Ice Bear are in the Bay Area seeking a ride home.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 3x43
episodes_data.description: Nom Nom's stress levels spike due to an unexpected resurgence in his popularity. At the suggestion of his doctor, Nom Nom decides to take a vacation at a eucalyptus spa. His doctor assigns Grizz as his "comfort pet", who must protect him from his ravid fans or else his stress levels will cause him to die.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x1
episodes_data.description: While on a fishing trip, the Bears get attacked by a giant legendary fish.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x2
episodes_data.description: The Bears win a tour of the infamous Googs corporate headquarters.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x3
episodes_data.description: The Bears win a tour of the infamous Googs corporate headquarters.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x4
episodes_data.description: The Baby Bears get jobs as paper boys.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x5
episodes_data.description: Tabes deputizes the Bears so they can go to the city and catch a thief.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x6
episodes_data.description: The Baby Bears build a submarine and explore the depths of an aquarium so they can bring a lost squid to its family.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x7
episodes_data.description: The Bears use a robot bear to help around the house. But things get tricky when they lose control of the robot.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x8
episodes_data.description: Baby Grizz lives on the set of a sitcom in which he stars. But when a cooler kid joins the cast, Grizz feels threatened.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x9
episodes_data.description: The Bears must complete their Best-Man duties on the day of Darrell's wedding.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x10
episodes_data.description: Grizz pitches his Crowbar Jones prequel film to Nom Nom, hoping Nom Nom will agree to appear in the movie.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x11
episodes_data.description: A quest for their favorite hot sauce causes the Bears to get involved with a sting operation.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x12
episodes_data.description: Hoping to finally get the mom-experience, the Bears use an app that'll bring a mom right to their door.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x13
episodes_data.description: To help distract Panda from his girl problems, Grizz and Ice Bear treat him to a ride in a limo.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x14
episodes_data.description: Through another video browsing session online, we get more videos uploaded by the Bears and their friends.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x15
episodes_data.description: The Bears help Chloe present her project for a college science contest, but Chloe’s rival makes things difficult.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x16
episodes_data.description: Tabes helps the Bears rescue Charlie after a villainous game hunter captures him.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x17
episodes_data.description: In a flashback to long ago, Charlie has an adventure in the Mexican desert.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x19
episodes_data.description: The Baby Bears enter a Mexican wrestling tournament.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x20
episodes_data.description: The Bears get pizza at Papa Bear's Pizza Cave and wind up replacing the place's animatronic band. They're such a hit that they go on tour!

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x21
episodes_data.description: The Baby Bears get adopted by an eccentric millionaire and get to live in his mansion.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x22
episodes_data.description: In order to get some sleep, the Bears help an annoying bird find a new mate.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x23
episodes_data.description: When the Bears go to the dentist, Panda gets braces. But, Panda finds out his braces grant him super abilities and the power goes to his head.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x24
episodes_data.description: On Christmas Eve, the Baby Bears defend a video store from getting robbed.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x25
episodes_data.description: The Baby Bears invent an imaginary friend, but the trouble he causes is all too real.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x26
episodes_data.description: The Bears go the mall and encounter their human counterparts.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x27
episodes_data.description: The Bears discover a network of tunnels underneath the cave. Are they prepared to discover where they lead to and who dug them?

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x28
episodes_data.description: The Baby Bears help a struggling ramen chef perfect her ramen and save her shop.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x29
episodes_data.description: At the suggestion of a member, the Bears decide to go to Mystique Physique Gym in see if they are "gym material". Grizz takes part in rock wall climbing only to be outdone by a child, Panda takes up virtual biking that goes from calm to terrifying and Ice Bear takes a tai-chi class where he goes up against some intimidating old ladies.

episodes_data.title: We Bare Bears 4x30
episodes_data.description: After watching a horror movie called Germs, Panda becomes a severe germaphobe. To solve the problem, he purchases a bubble for him to maneuver around in. Grizz and Ice Bear become annoyed, especially when he starts acting rude towards Charlie, but when Panda gets stuck in a waste dump and unable to escape, Charlie risks everything to save him.
